spec.title: LCP (p75)
spec.description: Largest Contentful Paint — time until the largest viewport element (usually the main image or heading) appears. Indicates when the page is visually usable. Good: <2.5 s.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} |= " lcp=" | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="measurement" | unwrap lcp [$__range]) by ()

spec.title: INP (p75)
spec.description: Interaction to Next Paint — worst-case delay between a user interaction (click, tap, keypress) and the next frame the browser paints in response. Measures how sluggish the page feels while being used. Reported only after a real interaction, so an empty panel means nobody interacted, not that the page is fast. Good: <200 ms.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} |= " inp=" | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="measurement" | unwrap inp [$__range]) by ()

spec.title: CLS
spec.description: Cumulative Layout Shift — dimensionless measure of unexpected layout shifts during page load (weighted sum of changes). Good: <0.1. Only Chromium-based browsers implement the Layout Instability API this builds on; Firefox reports no `layout-shift` entries, so the panel stays empty for Firefox-only traffic. That is a browser limitation, not a broken query.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} |= " cls=" | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="measurement" | unwrap cls [$__range]) by ()

spec.title: FCP (p75)
spec.description: First Contentful Paint — time until the first visual element (text, image, SVG) appears on screen. Indicates when the user sees the page begin to load. Good: <1.8 s.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} |= " fcp=" | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="measurement" | unwrap fcp [$__range]) by ()

spec.title: TTFB (p75)
spec.description: Time To First Byte — time from when the browser sends the request until it receives the first byte from the server. Measures network + server latency. Good: <600 ms.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} |= " ttfb=" | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="measurement" | unwrap ttfb [$__range]) by ()

spec.title: Page loads
spec.description: Grafana Cloud paints the page loads that hit an error in red; here the error count for the same interval is overlaid instead, which is the closest approximation LogQL allows without a per-session join.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name="faro.performance.navigation" [$__interval]))

sum(count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="exception" [$__interval]))

spec.title: Page load vitals (p75)
spec.description: p75 of TTFB, FCP and LCP from the Faro web-vitals events, split by app so a regression can be traced to one frontend.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} |= " ttfb=" | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="measurement" | unwrap ttfb [$__interval]) by (app)

quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} |= " fcp=" | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="measurement" | unwrap fcp [$__interval]) by (app)

quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} |= " lcp=" | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="measurement" | unwrap lcp [$__interval]) by (app)

spec.title: CLS (p75)
spec.description: Cumulative Layout Shift — dimensionless measure of unexpected layout shifts during page load (weighted sum of changes), at p75 over time. Good: <0.1. Only Chromium-based browsers implement the Layout Instability API this builds on; Firefox reports no `layout-shift` entries, so the panel stays empty for Firefox-only traffic. That is a browser limitation, not a broken query.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} |= " cls=" | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="measurement" | unwrap cls [$__interval]) by (app)

spec.title: Interactivity (p75)
spec.description: Interaction to Next Paint — worst-case delay between a user interaction and the next frame painted in response. Good: <200 ms. Reported only after a real interaction, so an empty panel means nobody interacted, not that interactivity is perfect. The FID series was removed: faro-web-sdk 2.4.0 bundles web-vitals 5, which dropped that metric in favour of INP and never emits it.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} |= " inp=" | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="measurement" | unwrap inp [$__interval]) by (app)

spec.title: Page performance
spec.description: Per-page p75 of each web vital plus its exception count. Grouping by `page_id` works on every kind of signal because it comes from Faro's `meta.page`. The CLS column is Chromium-only (see the CLS panels).

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} |= " lcp=" | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="measurement" | unwrap lcp [$__range]) by (page_id)

quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} |= " fcp=" | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="measurement" | unwrap fcp [$__range]) by (page_id)

quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} |= " ttfb=" | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="measurement" | unwrap ttfb [$__range]) by (page_id)

quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} |= " cls=" | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="measurement" | unwrap cls [$__range]) by (page_id)

quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} |= " inp=" | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="measurement" | unwrap inp [$__range]) by (page_id)

sum by (page_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="exception" [$__range]))

spec.title: Navigation phases (p75)
spec.description:
Per-phase breakdown of navigation timing at p75; stacked, so the bars show where the time goes.

`redirectTime` following redirects · `dnsLookupTime` resolving the name · `tcpHandshakeTime` opening the connection · `tlsNegotiationTime` the TLS handshake · `requestTime` sending the request · `responseTime` receiving it · `documentParsingTime` parsing the HTML · `domProcessingTime` parsing and executing scripts until the DOM is interactive · `onLoadTime` the window `load` handler, where high values point to expensive load-time JS.

All nine were confirmed present against a live deployment. The first four legitimately read 0 on a reused connection — a real measurement, not a missing field.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name="faro.performance.navigation" | event_data_redirectTime != "unknown" | unwrap event_data_redirectTime [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name="faro.performance.navigation" | event_data_dnsLookupTime != "unknown" | unwrap event_data_dnsLookupTime [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name="faro.performance.navigation" | event_data_tcpHandshakeTime != "unknown" | unwrap event_data_tcpHandshakeTime [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name="faro.performance.navigation" | event_data_tlsNegotiationTime != "unknown" | unwrap event_data_tlsNegotiationTime [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name="faro.performance.navigation" | event_data_requestTime != "unknown" | unwrap event_data_requestTime [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name="faro.performance.navigation" | event_data_responseTime != "unknown" | unwrap event_data_responseTime [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name="faro.performance.navigation" | event_data_documentParsingTime != "unknown" | unwrap event_data_documentParsingTime [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name="faro.performance.navigation" | event_data_domProcessingTime != "unknown" | unwrap event_data_domProcessingTime [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name="faro.performance.navigation" | event_data_onLoadTime != "unknown" | unwrap event_data_onLoadTime [$__interval]) by ()

spec.title: Slowest pages (top 20, p75 page load)
spec.description: Total page load time = `domComplete - fetchStart`: end-to-end from request start to fully rendered DOM, per route at p75.

spec.expr: topk(20, quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", user_attr_role=~"$role", app_version=~"$app_version"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name="faro.performance.navigation" | event_data_pageLoadTime != "unknown" | unwrap event_data_pageLoadTime [$__range]) by (page_id, app))

spec.title: Slowest resources (top 20, p75 fetch time)
spec.description: Default tracking: XHR + fetch only. Full URL retained — high cardinality is bounded by topk(20).

spec.expr: topk(20, quantile_over_time(0.75, {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", user_attr_role=~"$role", app_version=~"$app_version"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name="faro.performance.resource" | event_data_fetchTime != "unknown" | unwrap event_data_fetchTime [$__range]) by (event_data_name, event_data_initiatorType))

spec.title: Resource cache status
spec.description: Distribution of resource fetches by cacheHitStatus: fullLoad (network), cache (memory/disk), conditionalFetch (304).

spec.expr: sum by (event_data_cacheHitStatus) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", user_attr_role=~"$role", app_version=~"$app_version"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name="faro.performance.resource" [$__range]))

options.content:
This tab covers **every** HTTP request the frontends report: `request_completed` for successes (sampled by `FARO_HTTP_SAMPLING`, so rates are a sample when it is below `1.0`) and `request_failed` for failures. The KPI row and the RED panels below span both; the last four panels drill into failures only.

TTFB comes from `faro.performance.resource` because our own HTTP events do not carry it. `route_template` is not comparable across frontends: the Vue 3 client reports the OpenAPI path template, the old-frontend a normalised pathname.

spec.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {app=~"$app", source="faro"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name = "request_failed" | app_environment =~ "$environment" | user_attr_role =~ "$role" | app_version =~ "$app_version" | event_data_client =~ "$client" | event_data_error_type =~ "$error_type" | event_data_status =~ "$status" | event_data_duration_ms != "" | unwrap event_data_duration_ms [1m]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {app=~"$app", source="faro"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name = "request_failed" | app_environment =~ "$environment" | user_attr_role =~ "$role" | app_version =~ "$app_version" | event_data_client =~ "$client" | event_data_error_type =~ "$error_type" | event_data_status =~ "$status" | event_data_duration_ms != "" | unwrap event_data_duration_ms [1m]) by ()

spec.title: Top endpoints failing
spec.description: `route_template` is not comparable across frontends: the Vue 3 frontend emits the OpenAPI path template (`/item/desktop/{desktop_id}`), while the old-frontend and the webapp emit the request pathname with identifier-looking segments collapsed (`/api/v3/desktop/{id}`). Filter by `$app` before comparing routes.

options.content: There is no user action instrumentation yet: no frontend marks its elements with `data-faro-user-action-name`, which is what the SDK's user actions instrumentation reads to name an action, so no `faro.user.action` event ever reaches Loki. Both the instrumentation and the panels that would consume it (most frequent actions, duration per action) belong to phase F4.

spec.title: Console warn/error logs
spec.description: Anchored on `source="faro"` like every other panel: without a matcher that cannot match empty, a deployment where the `App` variable resolves to nothing makes Loki reject the query outright.

spec.expr: {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", user_attr_role=~"$role", app_version=~"$app_version"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="log" | level=~"error|warn"

spec.title: Recent exceptions
spec.description: Anchored on `source="faro"` like every other panel: without a matcher that cannot match empty, a deployment where the `App` variable resolves to nothing makes Loki reject the query outright.

spec.expr: {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", user_attr_role=~"$role", app_version=~"$app_version"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="exception" | line_format "[{{.type}}] {{.value}}  @ {{.view_name}}  user={{.user_id}}  session={{.session_id}}  browser={{.browser_name}}/{{.browser_os}}"

{app=~"$app", source="faro"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name = "request_failed" | app_environment =~ "$environment" | user_attr_role =~ "$role" | app_version =~ "$app_version" | event_data_client =~ "$client" | event_data_error_type =~ "$error_type" | event_data_status =~ "$status"

sum(count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="exception" [$__range])) or vector(0)

count(sum by (user_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="exception" | user_id != "" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="exception" | session_id != "" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

100 - 100 * (count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="exception" | session_id != "" [$__range]))) or vector(0)) / (count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | session_id != "" [$__range]))) or vector(1))

sum by (type) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="exception" [$__interval]))

spec.title: Top exceptions
spec.description: Each row links to the session detail dashboard. The link is a navigation shortcut only: it does not carry the exception filter, because that dashboard is scoped to a single session while this table is grouped by exception message. Enter a session ID there, or start from the Sessions tab, whose row links carry one.

spec.expr: topk(20, sum by (type, value) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="exception" [$__range])))

topk(20, sum by (page_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="exception" [$__range])))

sum by (browser_name, browser_version, browser_os) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="exception" [$__range]))

sum by (app_version, app_environment) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="exception" [$__range]))

topk(50, sum by (user_id, user_attr_role) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="exception" | user_id != "" [$__range])))

count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | session_id != "" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

count(sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="exception" | session_id != "" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name="session_start" [$__range])) or vector(0)

sum by (app) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name="session_start" [$__interval]))

spec.title: Sessions
spec.description: `User` and `Role` come from the session's own events, not from its `session_start`: the SDK pushes that one from inside `initializeFaro()`, before the app can attach an identity, so it is always anonymous. A session that authenticates mid-flight therefore lists the identity it ended up with.

spec.expr: {app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | event_name="session_start" | line_format "{{.session_id}}"

sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | kind="exception" | session_id != "" [$__range]))

sum by (session_id) (count_over_time({app=~"$app", source="faro", app_environment=~"$environment", app_version=~"$app_version", user_attr_role=~"$role"} | logfmt | browser_name =~ "$browser" | browser_os =~ "$os" | page_id =~ "$page_id" | session_id != "" [$__range]))
